source_ref: Biswas MNU, Rahman MA, Al Masud A (2024) PLOS ONE 19(6):e0304178, doi:10.1371/journal.pone.0304178, Table 2 (item wording), Table 4 (alpha); S1 Dataset .sav (s001) value labels; data/biswas_2024_digital_center_quality.py
note: Item text for 22 of 26 items is verbatim from the paper's Table 2 ('Latent and Measured Variables', Biswas, Rahman & Al Masud 2024, PLOS ONE 10.1371/journal.pone.0304178, CC BY 4.0), which prints each item against its code. 19 codes (INFQ1-4, SYSQ1-3, SERQ1-3, SPES1-3, ACCS1-3, CONI1-3) match the data's column names exactly (data/biswas_2024_digital_center_quality.py melts the S1 .sav columns under their own names, no rename). The data's PAR1-3 are printed as CITP1-3 (Citizen Participation); tied by construct name and same-number order, which is an inference. CONI4-7 are in the S1 .sav and the live table but the paper prints no wording for them (Table 2 lists CONI1-3 only; Table 4's CONI alpha .794 reproduces from CONI1-3 alone, not CONI1-7 = .685), and none of the four other supplements (s002-s005, reviewer correspondence .docx) contain the questionnaire; their item_text is left blank, with the 5 option rows only. CONI4-7 correlate only -0.10..0.09 with CONI1-3 (0.23..0.32 for CONI7) and 0.49..0.57 among CONI4-6, so they look like a separate block and their content cannot be inferred. CONI3 is printed as negatively worded ('...would like to discontinue coming to the UDC for services.', 'UDC' kept verbatim, presumably a carry-over from Biswas & Roy's Union Digital Center study), but in the data it correlates +0.29..+0.65 with every other item from CONI1-3 and the other six blocks, and the paper's CONI alpha .794 is computed with it positively keyed; so it was either reverse-scored before deposit or the printed wording does not match what was administered. The table cannot tell which, and it is disclosed in public_note. The .sav has no variable labels (all None); option_text comes from each item's own .sav value labels (1..5), transcribed verbatim including their inconsistent casing and typos ('Vaery Agree' on ACCS2, 'disagee' on CONI6). The paper describes the scale as 'Strongly Disagree (1) to (5) Strongly Agree'. Language: the paper says 'The questionnaire was initially adopted in English and further translated into Bangla for easy understanding of the respondents'. No Bangla text is in the deposit (the .sav holds only English value labels) or the supplements (s002-s005, English reviewer correspondence), so English sits in the base fields under the translated_substitute fallback, language=Bengali, translation_source=study_supplied (the authors' own English). The paper prints no participant instructions, so instructions is blank. Rights: a study-built questionnaire adapted from the literature (Wang & Liao; Kang & Lee; Mouakket; Biswas & Roy; Zhang; Wangpipatwong et al.; Yeh & Teng), not a named commercial instrument; the paper is CC BY 4.0 and the deposit CC0. No fee, permission, non-commercial, no-derivatives or no-redistribution clause was found. Silence is permission, so it is not blocked.
public_note: Item text is given for 22 of 26 items: the paper prints no wording for CONI4-CONI7, which are left blank. The items were administered in Bangla and are shown in the authors' English. CONI3 is printed as a negatively worded item ('would like to discontinue'), but it correlates positively (r 0.29-0.65) with every other item, so it appears to have been reverse-scored before deposit or the printed wording differs from what was administered. PAR1-PAR3 correspond to the paper's CITP1-CITP3.
